# fivenines_uptime_monitors (Data Source)

Lists the uptime monitors in the organization. All filters are optional and are combined; omitting them returns every monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every monitor in the organization.
data "fivenines_uptime_monitors" "all" {}

# Filters are optional and combine.
data "fivenines_uptime_monitors" "failing_https" {
  status   = "down"
  protocol = "https"
}

# Free-text search over name, URL and hostname.
data "fivenines_uptime_monitors" "api" {
  query     = "api"
  order     = "name"
  direction = "asc"
}

# Only monitors touched since a given point in time.
data "fivenines_uptime_monitors" "recently_changed" {
  updated_since = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

output "down_urls" {
  value = data.fivenines_uptime_monitors.failing_https.monitors[*].url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Sort direction: "asc" or "desc".
- `order` (String) Column to sort by. The API defines the sortable columns; an unsupported value is rejected by the API at refresh time rather than at plan time.
- `protocol` (String) Only return monitors using this protocol: "https", "tcp", "icmp" or "dns".
- `query` (String) Free-text search across monitor name, URL and hostname (the API's `q` filter).
- `status` (String) Only return monitors in this status: "unknown", "up", "down", "paused" or "recovering".
- `updated_since` (String) Only return monitors updated at or after this ISO8601 timestamp.

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) Matching uptime monitors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `hostname` (String) Monitored hostname, for tcp/icmp/dns monitors.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID).
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Check interval in seconds.
- `last_check_at` (String) Last check time.
- `last_error` (String) Last error message.
- `name` (String) Monitor name.
- `next_check_at` (String) Next scheduled check time.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is currently paused.
- `port` (Number) Monitored port, for tcp monitors.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol being monitored.
- `ssl_expires_at` (String) SSL certificate expiration date.
- `status` (String) Current status: "unknown", "up", "down", "paused" or "recovering".
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `url` (String) Monitored URL, for https monitors.
